title: Simple DNA Extraction for Phytoplankton Using Chelex 100
author: G Jason Smith
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.h58b89w

steps.title: Prepare Chelex Extraction Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the extraction buffer in a clean 50 mL Falcon Tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 5.0 g Chelex 100 (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #C7901-100G) to the tube.
Add 0.5 g Polyvinylpolypyrrolidone (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #77627-25G) to the same tube.
Resuspend in 50 mL nuclease free H2O by vortexing to hydrate.

steps.title: Filter and Wash Phytoplankton Samples
steps.instruction: Filter the samples and perform washing steps to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Filter samples using 25 mm polycarbonate filters.
Wash sample and collect suspension by centrifugation at 3000 xg for 10 min.
Decant supernatant and repeat the nuclease free H2O wash.

steps.title: Equilibrate Sample with TE Buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend and wash the sample pellet using TE buffer.

substeps.instruction: Decant supernatant and resuspend pellet in 50 mL 0.1X TE buffer (pH = 8).
Incubate sample with mixing for 10 min.
Centrifuge to collect suspension at 3000 xg for 10 min.
Decant supernatant and resuspend pellet in 50 mL 0.1X TE buffer (pH = 8).

steps.title: Perform DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract DNA from the filtered sample or cell pellet using the Chelex suspension.

substeps.instruction: For filtered samples: Aliquot 300 µL of the mixed Chelex suspension (ensure complete resuspension prior to aliquoting) into a 1.5 mL tube and add the filter into the tube without folding it.
For cell pellets: Add 300 µL Chelex suspension directly to the pellet (volume can be adjusted for biomass).
Seal the tube and vortex to resuspend the cell sample.
Heat the suspended sample at 65°C for 5 min.
Vortex and centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 3 min to sediment particles.

steps.title: Prepare DNA for PCR
steps.instruction: Dilute the resulting DNA extract supernatant for downstream assays.

substeps.instruction: Dilute DNA extract supernatant 1:10 with TE buffer at pH = 8 for PCR assays.

steps.title: Optional DNA Purification
steps.instruction: Increase DNA concentration and quality if necessary.

substeps.instruction: Use Zymo Genomic DNA Clean & Concentrator-10 spin columns (Zymo Research Catalog #D4011) following the manufacturer's protocol.
